title: ulmus carpinifolia f. pendula
intro: Ulmus carpinifolia f. pendula, commonly known as Weeping Carpinus, is a variant of the Carpinus carpinifolia tree, characterized by its pendulous branches and foliage. The Weeping Carpinus is known to have various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Weeping Carpinus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
